scientific_integrity: No independent validation; the proof uses a previously published natural chain comparison and an explicit new equivariant algebra deduction.
scientific_limitations: Configuration of unordered particles on a single star only.
The decomposition is into restricted GL Schur functors, not a list of irreducible Specht constituents.
Potential equivalent unindexed literature and independent proof review remain open.
title: Hook-Schur homology and the first symmetric cycle for particles on star graphs
